title: Benchmarking AI Models Using Surveys
description:
Recommended: Basic knowledge of Python; Able to obtain API access/tokens for advanced LLM services (e.g., OpenAI or Google). We will cover API usage during the course, so prior experience is not required.
Additional information: This course will be a part of the lineup of online courses and students will be able to count this course as an elective toward any of the JPSM online programs: MPDS, and certificates Z127, Z129, and Z133.
